events.description: A three-round corporate readiness challenge assessing communication, leadership, interview performance, and crisis handling skills.
rules: Round 1: Group Discussion – evaluates communication, awareness, teamwork & articulation.
Round 2: Mock Interview – HR-style interview based on personality, communication & persuasion.
Round 3: Corporate Strategy + Risk Management – participants propose business solutions within 10 mins followed by evaluation.

events.description: A startup pitching challenge conducted in two stages — quiz followed by a business pitch presentation.
rules: Round 1: Offline quiz on startups & entrepreneurship (40 MCQs, no negative marking, 30% qualifying score).
Round 2: PPT Pitching Round – teams present business plan in under 10 slides (excluding cover & final slide).
Presentation must include motivation, feasibility, revenue, marketing and financial strategy.

events.description: A multi-round advertising challenge involving quizzes, live ad-analysis and final ad-film production.
rules: Round 1: Brain Teaser – 15-minute online quiz (20 advertisement-based questions) taken individually by both members.
Round 2: Evolution – video advertisement shown, participants write analysis on A4 sheet within 20 minutes.
Round 3: Thinkistaan – creative ad-making round (1.5 to 3-minute ad) followed by Q&A panel.

events.description: A stock-market based analytical event testing fundamentals of finance, trading mindset and portfolio strategy under simulated conditions.
rules: Round 1: The Financial Forum – MCQ-based assessment covering stock basics, concepts & market awareness.
Round 2: The Trading Turf – simulated trading session to maximize profits using strategic decisions.
Eligibility: Open to all interested in stock trading.
